page_title: VIL 5-1 GRA | Villarreal v Granada CF 03/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The match has just finished.

90+1' 5 - 1 Theodor Corbeanu (Granada CF) meets a perfect cross from Sergio Ruiz on the edge of the penalty area and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike straight into the left side of the goal. It's 5:1.
90' We will have 2 min. of added time.

90' Theodor Corbeanu (Granada CF) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the bottom right corner, but Pepe Reina denies him with a great save.
89' Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul after Manu Trigueros (Villarreal) hacks down one of his opponents.
87' Theodor Corbeanu (Granada CF) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
86' Manu Trigueros (Villarreal) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Juan Pulido no option but to blow his whistle.
84' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) gets booked for the first time in this match.
84' Manu Trigueros (Villarreal) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
82' Here's the change. Gonzalo Villar leaves the pitch and Oscar Melendo (Granada CF) comes on as a substitute.
82' Substitution. Lucas Boye walks off the pitch and Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) comes on as a substitute.
82' Alexander Medina has decided to substitute Facundo Pellistri and he is replaced by Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF).
76' Granada CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
75' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) for Bertrand Traore.
74' Villarreal take a short corner kick.
73' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal), whose low effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
70' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
69' Surely that's handball by one of the Villarreal players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

66' 5 - 0 Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Dani Parejo. His header was precise and ended up inside the right post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 5:0.
66' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Villarreal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
66' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) fires the resulting free kick towards the roof of the net from the edge of the box, but Augusto Batalla pulls off a superb save to deny him.
65' Bertrand Traore (Villarreal) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
65' Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
63' Theodor Corbeanu (Granada CF) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Martin Hongla.
62' It is time for a substitution. Bruno Mendez (Granada CF) is on for Kamil Piatkowski.
62' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Stefan Lekovic (Villarreal) replaces Aissa Mandi.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Manu Trigueros (Villarreal) comes onto the pitch so that Alex Baena can be given a rest.
61' Alex Baena (Villarreal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
59' Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
55' The game is interrupted now, Aissa Mandi (Villarreal) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
55' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) judges the lofted pass perfectly and heads straight towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Pepe Reina.
54' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
54' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
51' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
50' The ball goes out of play. Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.

47' 4 - 0 It's a goal! Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the bottom right corner. The assist goes to Alex Baena and the score changes to 4:0.
46' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) takes a wild swing at a rebound from mid-range and it goes well wide of the right post.
46' Alex Baena (Villarreal) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Marcelino gives a chance to Goncalo Guedes and Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is off.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Marcelino probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Eric Bailly. He is replaced by Aissa Mandi (Villarreal).
46' Referee Juan Pulido blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
45+5' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Martin Hongla (Granada CF) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
39' Villarreal move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.
35' Villarreal work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
32' 3 - 0 The resulting corner is whipped in by Dani Parejo and Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) is left unmarked to plant a precise header into the top of the net. The score is 3:0.
32' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) will take the corner.
32' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Bertrand Traore (Villarreal), whose effort would probably have ended inside the left post.
27' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Juan Pulido has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
24' Now Granada CF have a corner.
24' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
19' 2 - 0 Goal! Dani Parejo puts a cross into the box and finds Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the middle of the net. He makes it 2:0.
19' A clumsy foul by Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) and Juan Pulido blows his whistle.
16' Close effort! Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) takes the resulting free kick from a promising distance, but he sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
15' Kamil Piatkowski (Granada CF) has tested the patience of referee Juan Pulido and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
10' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
9' Granada CF take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
7' 1 - 0 Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) finds his way to a high rebound and doesn't hesitate to blast it to the top right corner.
7' OFF THE BAR! Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball crashes against the crossbar.
7' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) trips an opposition player and Juan Pulido signals a foul.
5' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Villarreal.
1' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Granada CF will have the kick-off.
Juan Pulido will referee today's match.
